recipes.title: James Hoffmann French Press
recipes.description: James Hoffmann's no-plunge French press: steep, stir the crust, skim, rest, then pour off the settled brew for a clean, sludge-free cup.

steps.instruction: pour all the water onto the grounds
stir the crust, then scoop off the foam and floating grounds
rest 5–8 more minutes — longer is fine, the brew only settles
press the plunger just to the surface of the liquid, no further
pour gently, leaving the last sips (and the sediment) behind
